label: Teltonika RUT140
description: Industrial wired router: 1x 100 Mbps WAN, 1x 100 Mbps LAN.
notes: Vendor figures from the RUT140 datasheet: **1x WAN and 1x LAN, 10/100 Mbps**. Two fast-Ethernet ports and no radio - a DIN-rail router for a single industrial feed, with no second LAN port to hang anything from.
